levels.surface: الحسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن علي التميمي
علي بن موسى بن جعفر بن محمد

notes: «سيدي» before علي بن موسى is an honorific for the transmitter, left out

«أبيه» + name is one link (rule 7): جعفر بن محمد، محمد بن علي، علي، الحسين and the last علي are named by their own names; the Imams named after «عن» in the chain stay narrators (owner ruling 2 covers only words after the chain)
The last link is علي, whose words relay the Prophet's saying; the Prophet is the end
Occurrence numbers are given because «أبي», «علي» and «محمد بن علي» stand several times in the text
